def_en: Anthropic's Python/TS toolkit for building agentic apps — 'Claude Code as a library': the agent loop, subagents, tool integration, context management, and lifecycle hooks. Formerly the Claude Code SDK.
def_zh: Anthropic 用於建構代理式應用的 Python/TS 工具組——「把 Claude Code 當函式庫」:代理迴圈、子代理、工具整合、上下文管理與生命週期 hooks。前身為 Claude Code SDK。

def_en: The cycle of model call → tool execution → feeding results back, repeating until the model returns end_turn.
def_zh: 「模型呼叫 → 執行工具 → 回傳結果」的循環,反覆進行直到模型回傳 end_turn。

def_en: A separate agent the coordinator delegates a sub-task to, with its own isolated context.
def_zh: 協調者委派子任務的獨立代理,擁有自己隔離的上下文。

def_en: The lead agent that splits work into sub-tasks, delegates them to specialized subagents, then synthesizes the results.
def_zh: 負責拆解工作、委派給專門子代理,再綜整結果的主導代理。

def_en: A lifecycle callback that runs before or after a tool call to inspect, modify, or filter it.
def_zh: 在工具呼叫前或後執行的生命週期回呼,可檢視、修改或過濾該呼叫。

def_en: The list restricting which tools an agent may call; a coordinator must include 'Task' to spawn subagents.
def_zh: 限制代理可呼叫哪些工具的清單;協調者必須包含 'Task' 才能產生子代理。

def_en: The built-in tool an agent uses to spawn a subagent for an independent unit of work.
def_zh: 代理用來為獨立工作單元產生子代理的內建工具。

def_en: The response field saying why generation stopped: end_turn, tool_use, max_tokens, stop_sequence, pause_turn, or refusal.
def_zh: 回應中說明為何停止生成的欄位:end_turn、tool_use、max_tokens、stop_sequence、pause_turn 或 refusal。

def_en: The response block where the model requests a tool call with structured JSON input.
def_zh: 模型以結構化 JSON 輸入請求呼叫工具的回應區塊。

def_en: The request setting controlling tool use: auto, any, a forced specific tool, or none.
def_zh: 控制工具使用方式的請求設定:auto、any、強制特定工具,或 none。

def_en: Issuing multiple independent tool calls in one turn; all results are returned together in a single user message.
def_zh: 在同一回合發出多個獨立工具呼叫;所有結果一併放入單一使用者訊息回傳。

def_en: The separate instruction field that sets the model's role, constraints, and output format for the whole conversation.
def_zh: 另外設定的指令欄位,為整段對話定義模型的角色、限制與輸出格式。

def_en: The total tokens the model processes at once: system prompt + full history + tool definitions + tool results.
def_zh: 模型一次能處理的 token 總量:系統提示 + 完整歷史 + 工具定義 + 工具結果。

def_en: The tendency to attend reliably to the start and end of a long input but miss details in the middle.
def_zh: 模型對長輸入的開頭與結尾較可靠,卻容易忽略中段細節的傾向。

def_en: Compressing earlier history to save context; risks losing exact numbers, percentages, and dates.
def_zh: 壓縮較早的歷史以節省上下文;有遺失精確數字、百分比與日期的風險。

def_en: An external file the agent writes intermediate findings to, keeping the context window lean.
def_zh: 代理把中間發現寫入的外部檔案,讓上下文視窗保持精簡。

def_en: Reusing a stable prompt prefix across requests to cut cost and latency; any byte change in the prefix invalidates it.
def_zh: 跨請求重用穩定的提示前綴以降低成本與延遲;前綴只要有一個位元組改變就會失效。

def_en: An open standard for connecting models to external tools, resources, and data via MCP servers.
def_zh: 透過 MCP 伺服器將模型連接到外部工具、資源與資料的開放標準。

def_en: A backend exposing tools and resources to the model over MCP; it handles authentication outside the prompt.
def_zh: 以 MCP 將工具與資源提供給模型的後端;在提示之外處理驗證。

def_en: A stable MCP extension (June 2026) that governs MCP server access centrally through the org's identity provider (SSO): admins enable a server for the org, users get it automatically by their existing groups/roles, and revocation is instant—no per-user OAuth consent.
def_zh: 穩定版 MCP 擴充(2026 年 6 月),透過組織身分提供者(SSO)集中治理 MCP 伺服器存取:管理員為組織啟用伺服器,使用者依既有群組/角色自動取得存取權,撤銷即時——不需逐人 OAuth 同意。

zh: MCP 工具 vs 資源
def_en: Tools are actions the model can invoke; resources are data the model can read.
def_zh: 工具是模型可叫用的動作;資源是模型可讀取的資料。

def_en: The flag marking a tool result as an error so the model can recover rather than treat it as success.
def_zh: 將工具結果標示為錯誤的旗標,讓模型得以復原而非當成成功。

zh: 結構化錯誤(類別+可重試)
def_en: Returning tool errors with a category and a retryable flag so the model retries transient failures and escalates permanent ones.
def_zh: 回傳帶有類別與可重試旗標的工具錯誤,讓模型重試暫時性失敗、升級永久性失敗。

def_en: The project file declaring MCP servers for the team; user-level config lives in ~/.claude.json.
def_zh: 為團隊宣告 MCP 伺服器的專案檔;使用者層級設定放在 ~/.claude.json。

def_en: Claude Code's persistent project memory; conventions here load automatically every session (user → project → directory hierarchy).
def_zh: Claude Code 的持久專案記憶;此處的慣例每次工作階段自動載入(使用者 → 專案 → 目錄階層)。

def_en: Path-scoped rule files that load conditionally via a 'paths' glob, so rules apply only to matching files.
def_zh: 以 'paths' glob 條件式載入的路徑範圍化規則檔,規則只套用於符合的檔案。

def_en: A reusable, invokable workflow saved as a project or user command (unified with skills).
def_zh: 存成專案或使用者命令的可重複、可叫用工作流程(已與技能整合)。

def_en: A folder with a SKILL.md whose short description stays in context; the full instructions load on demand when relevant.
def_zh: 含 SKILL.md 的資料夾,其簡短描述常駐上下文;完整指令在相關時才按需載入。

def_en: A skill/subagent setting that runs work in an isolated context and returns only a summary, protecting the main context.
def_zh: 讓工作在隔離上下文中執行、只回傳摘要的技能/子代理設定,可保護主上下文。

def_en: A Claude Code mode that produces and confirms an approach before making any edits — best for large or ambiguous changes.
def_zh: Claude Code 在進行任何編輯前先產出並確認做法的模式 —— 最適合大型或模糊的變更。

def_en: A Claude Code command that condenses the conversation to free up context.
def_zh: Claude Code 用來壓縮對話以釋放上下文的命令。

def_en: Branching a session so a side task runs without polluting the main session's context.
def_zh: 分叉工作階段,讓支線任務在不污染主工作階段上下文的情況下執行。

def_en: Running Claude Code non-interactively for CI/scripts; pair with --output-format json for machine-readable output.
def_zh: 以非互動方式執行 Claude Code 供 CI/腳本使用;搭配 --output-format json 取得機器可讀輸出。

def_en: Claude Code's core file/shell tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob (plus Task for subagents).
def_zh: Claude Code 的核心檔案/shell 工具:Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Grep、Glob(加上用於子代理的 Task)。

zh: 用 Grep/Glob 而非 Bash 搜尋
def_en: Prefer Grep/Glob for code search — structured, parallel-safe results — over piping files through Bash.
def_zh: 搜尋程式碼優先用 Grep/Glob —— 結果結構化、可平行安全 —— 而非把檔案透過 Bash 倒出。

zh: JSON 結構描述(結構化輸出)
def_en: Defining the exact output shape so the model returns reliably parseable, well-typed data via tool_use.
def_zh: 定義精確的輸出形狀,讓模型透過 tool_use 回傳可靠可解析、型別良好的資料。

zh: strict 模式(嚴格工具使用)
def_en: Enforcing the schema at generation time so tool inputs conform exactly — no missing keys, no extras.
def_zh: 在生成時強制套用結構描述,使工具輸入完全相符 —— 不缺鍵、不多餘。

zh: 可為 null / 選填欄位
def_en: Schema design that lets the model represent 'not present' instead of fabricating a value.
def_zh: 讓模型能表示「不存在」而非捏造數值的結構描述設計。

def_en: Capturing known categories with an enum plus an 'other' value and a detail field for the long tail.
def_zh: 用 enum 擷取已知類別,再以 'other' 值與細節欄位處理長尾。

def_en: Giving the model a few targeted examples to steer behavior on ambiguous cases.
def_zh: 給模型少量針對性範例,以在模糊情況下引導其行為。

def_en: Decomposing a task into sequential focused passes, each handling one step.
def_zh: 把任務拆成連續、聚焦的多個步驟,每步處理一件事。

def_en: Catching schema-valid-but-wrong output with semantic validation (e.g. Pydantic) and feeding failures back for correction.
def_zh: 用語意驗證(如 Pydantic)抓出「符合結構描述卻錯誤」的輸出,並把失敗回饋以供修正。

def_en: Asynchronous bulk processing at ~50% cost for large, non-latency-sensitive jobs (results within ~24h).
def_zh: 為大量、非延遲敏感的工作提供約 5 折成本的非同步批次處理(約 24 小時內完成)。

def_en: The per-request identifier used to match batch results, which arrive in any order.
def_zh: 用來對應批次結果(結果順序不定)的每筆請求識別碼。

def_en: Handing off to a person on a policy gap, explicit request, or repeated inability to progress — with the gathered context.
def_zh: 在政策缺口、明確要求,或反覆無法推進時,帶著已蒐集的脈絡交給人處理。

def_en: Scoring per-field confidence and calibrating it on a labeled, stratified sample to set auto-accept vs review thresholds.
def_zh: 對各欄位評分信心,並以已標註、分層的樣本校準,以設定自動接受 vs 人工審查的門檻。

def_en: Tracking claim→source mappings so outputs are verifiable and conflicts are annotated, not silently resolved.
def_zh: 追蹤「主張→來源」對應,使輸出可驗證、衝突被註記而非默默處理。

def_en: Letting the model decide when and how much to reason (thinking: adaptive), tuned via the effort parameter — replaces fixed budget_tokens.
def_zh: 讓模型自行決定何時、思考多少(thinking: adaptive),以 effort 參數調整 —— 取代固定的 budget_tokens。

def_en: Designing destructive tools so repeats don't double-apply, and gating them behind confirmation/permissions.
def_zh: 設計破壞性工具使重複執行不會重複套用,並以確認/權限把關。

def_en: Promote an action to a dedicated, typed tool when the harness must gate, validate, render, or audit it; use bash for breadth.
def_zh: 當框架需要把關、驗證、渲染或稽核某動作時,將其提升為專用、具型別的工具;廣度需求才用 bash。

def_en: Workflow = LLMs + tools on predefined code paths (you control the flow); agent = the model dynamically directs its own process.
def_zh: 工作流 = 以預定程式碼路徑編排 LLM 與工具(你控制流程);代理 = 模型自行動態主導流程。

def_en: Workflow pattern: a central LLM breaks a task down, delegates to worker LLMs, and synthesizes their results.
def_zh: 工作流模式:中央 LLM 拆解任務、委派給工人 LLM,再綜整結果。

def_en: Workflow pattern: one LLM generates, another evaluates against a rubric and feeds back, looping to refine.
def_zh: 工作流模式:一個 LLM 生成,另一個依評分標準評估並回饋,反覆精修。

def_en: The infrastructure around the model (tool execution, context lifecycle, state, permissions, verification) that turns a model into an agent.
def_zh: 包在模型外、把模型變成代理的基礎架構:工具執行、上下文生命週期、狀態、權限、驗證。

def_en: Designing the agent's iterate loop — especially a generator plus an independent evaluator — instead of crafting one-shot prompts.
def_zh: 設計代理的迭代迴圈(尤其產生者 + 獨立評估者),而非打磨一次性提示。

def_en: The tool surface an agent acts through; invest in clear descriptions and schemas as much as you would a human UI.
def_zh: 代理據以行動的工具介面;清楚的描述與結構描述要像人機介面一樣用心。

def_en: output_config.effort (low–max) controls reasoning depth and total token spend; xhigh is the coding/agentic sweet spot.
def_zh: output_config.effort(low–max)控制推理深度與整體 token 花費;xhigh 是程式/代理的甜蜜點。

def_en: An advisory token ceiling for a whole agentic loop; the model sees a countdown and paces itself (distinct from max_tokens).
def_zh: 給整個代理迴圈的建議 token 上限;模型看到倒數並自我調配(有別於 max_tokens)。

def_en: Constrains the response to a JSON schema (constrained decoding) so the output is always valid, typed JSON; replaces the old output_format.
def_zh: 以 JSON 結構描述約束回應(constrained decoding),使輸出永遠是合法、型別化的 JSON;取代舊的 output_format。

def_en: Recall degrades as the context window fills; bigger windows don't always help — prune to high-signal tokens.
def_zh: 上下文視窗填滿時回想力下降;視窗更大未必更好 —— 修剪成高訊號 token。

def_en: Keep lightweight references (paths/URLs) and load content at runtime via tools, instead of pre-loading everything.
def_zh: 保留輕量參照(路徑/URL),執行期才用工具載入內容,而非事先全載。

def_en: Server-side summarization of older history near the context limit; echo response.content back to preserve the compacted state.
def_zh: 接近上限時伺服器端摘要較早歷史;要把 response.content 接回以保留壓縮狀態。

def_en: Clearing (not summarizing) stale tool results or thinking blocks from the transcript to keep it lean.
def_zh: 清除(非摘要)歷程中過時的工具結果或思考區塊,使其精簡。

def_en: Server-side tool: live web search with citations, run on Anthropic's infrastructure (just declare it in tools).
def_zh: 伺服器端工具:即時網路搜尋附引用,在 Anthropic 基礎設施執行(只要在 tools 宣告)。

def_en: Server-side sandboxed Python/bash container the model uses to run code (free when paired with web tools).
def_zh: 伺服器端沙箱 Python/bash 容器,供模型執行程式碼(與 web 工具併用時免費)。

def_en: Discover tools on demand from a large library (mark the rest defer_loading); schemas are appended, preserving the cache.
def_zh: 從大型工具庫按需探索工具(其餘標 defer_loading);結構描述以附加方式載入,可保留快取。

def_en: Claude calls your tools from inside code execution; intermediate results stay out of context, only the final output returns.
def_zh: Claude 從 code execution 內部呼叫你的工具;中間結果不進上下文,只回傳最終輸出。

def_en: Client-side Anthropic-defined tool; Claude reads/writes a /memories directory for cross-session state (you implement the backend).
def_zh: 用戶端 Anthropic 定義工具;Claude 讀寫 /memories 目錄做跨工作階段狀態(後端由你實作)。

def_en: Upload a file once, then reference it by file_id across many requests (PDF/text/image), instead of re-sending bytes.
def_zh: 檔案上傳一次,之後跨多個請求以 file_id 引用(PDF/文字/影像),不必重送位元組。

def_en: Anthropic-hosted agents: Anthropic runs the loop AND a per-session container; object model is Agent → Session → Environment.
def_zh: Anthropic 託管代理:Anthropic 跑迴圈並提供每工作階段容器;物件模型為 Agent → Session → Environment。

def_en: Agent = persisted, versioned config (model/system/tools), created ONCE and referenced by id; Session = one run that points to it.
def_zh: Agent = 持久、有版本的設定(model/system/tools),建立一次並以 id 引用;Session = 指向它的一次執行。

def_en: Credential store (MCP OAuth, static bearer, env-var secrets) injected at egress — secrets never enter the sandbox.
def_zh: 憑證庫(MCP OAuth、靜態 bearer、環境變數祕密),在 egress 注入 —— 祕密永不進入沙箱。

def_en: stdio (local subprocess) and Streamable HTTP (remote) are the two standard MCP transports; the SSE-only transport is deprecated.
def_zh: stdio(本機子行程)與 Streamable HTTP(遠端)是兩種標準 MCP 傳輸;純 SSE 傳輸已棄用。

def_en: Messages API feature letting Claude call a remote MCP server server-side via mcp_servers[] + an mcp_toolset entry.
def_zh: Messages API 功能,讓 Claude 透過 mcp_servers[] + mcp_toolset 在伺服器端呼叫遠端 MCP 伺服器。

def_en: Next MCP revision (RC locked 2026-05-21, final 2026-07-28; current stable is 2025-11-25): a stateless protocol core (capabilities move to _meta, any request can hit any server instance), an independently-versioned Extensions framework (reverse-DNS ids, ext-* repos) carrying Tasks and MCP Apps, and OAuth hardening (RFC 9207 iss validation, a formal 12-month deprecation policy).
def_zh: 下一版 MCP 修訂(RC 於 2026-05-21 鎖定,正式發布 2026-07-28;當前穩定版為 2025-11-25):無狀態協定核心(能力移入 _meta,任何請求可打到任何伺服器實例)、獨立版本化的 Extensions 框架(反向 DNS id、ext-* 儲存庫)承載 Tasks 與 MCP Apps,以及 OAuth 加固(RFC 9207 iss 驗證、正式的 12 個月棄用政策)。

def_en: The test suite for agents: code/model/human graders over realistic tasks, grading outcomes AND trajectories; use pass@k.
def_zh: 代理的測試套件:以程式碼/模型/人評分者在真實任務上評測,評結果與軌跡;用 pass@k。

def_en: An eval metric for non-deterministic agents: does it succeed within k attempts? Run multiple trials rather than judging one.
def_zh: 不確定性代理的評測指標:k 次嘗試內是否成功?跑多次而非只看單次。

def_en: Authenticate to the Claude API with a short-lived OIDC token from your own identity provider (AWS, GCP, Entra ID, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, SPIFFE, Okta) instead of a static API key. The token is exchanged at POST /v1/oauth/token for a scoped Anthropic token acting as a service account — no standing secret to rotate or leak.
def_zh: 以自有身分供應商(AWS、GCP、Entra ID、GitHub Actions、Kubernetes、SPIFFE、Okta)簽發的短期 OIDC token 驗證 Claude API,取代靜態 API key。該 token 在 POST /v1/oauth/token 換取一個以服務帳號身分運作、受範圍限制的 Anthropic token——沒有需要輪替或可能外洩的長期密鑰。

def_en: Anthropic's agentic scientific-research platform (launched 2026-06-30): 60+ scientific-database connectors, protein-structure prediction, and automated biology/chemistry research workflows.
def_zh: Anthropic 的代理式科學研究平台(2026-06-30 推出):60+ 科學資料庫連接器、蛋白質結構預測,以及自動化的生物/化學研究工作流程。

def_en: Anthropic's agentic AI for knowledge work: Claude Code's agent architecture running inside Claude Desktop (no terminal) for non-developers. Reads and writes local files, coordinates sub-agents into parallel workstreams, and produces artifacts like Excel workbooks and PowerPoint decks. Available on all paid plans.
def_zh: Anthropic 面向知識工作的代理式 AI:把 Claude Code 的代理架構搬進 Claude Desktop(不需終端機),供非開發者使用。可讀寫本機檔案、將子代理協調成平行工作流,並產出 Excel 活頁簿、PowerPoint 簡報等產物。所有付費方案皆可使用。

def_en: Claude as a shared team member, starting in Slack: tag @Claude in a channel to delegate a task and it works through stages with its connected tools, replying in-thread. Multiplayer (one Claude per channel that everyone shares), keeps channel memory, and can run an ambient mode that proactively surfaces information. Uses an agent-identity access model — the agent has its own team-wide identity rather than borrowing a person's.
def_zh: 讓 Claude 成為共享的團隊成員,起點在 Slack:在頻道中 @Claude 委派任務,它會以連接的工具分階段完成,並在討論串中回覆。多人協作(每個頻道一個由所有人共享的 Claude)、保有頻道記憶,並可啟用主動浮現資訊的環境感知(ambient)模式。採用代理身分存取模型——代理擁有自己的團隊層級身分,而非借用某個人的身分。

def_en: The Claude Certified Architect — Professional exam (v1.0, July 2026): 63 multiple-choice/multiple-response items, 120 min, pass 720/1000, $175, credential valid 12 months (free on-time renewal). Seven domains — Integration (19%) is the heaviest. This guide's PART V covers the blueprint and delta topics.
def_zh: Claude Certified Architect — Professional 考試(v1.0,2026 年 7 月):63 題單選/複選混合、120 分鐘、及格 720/1000、$175,證照效期 12 個月(準時續證免費)。七大領域——整合(19%)權重最高。本指南第五部分涵蓋考綱與增量主題。

def_en: Retrieve relevant chunks from an indexed corpus at query time and feed them to the model: ingest → chunk → embed → index → retrieve → (rerank) → generate. When answers turn confident-but-wrong after a data refresh with the model unchanged, suspect the retrieval layer first.
def_zh: 查詢時從已索引語料檢索相關片段餵給模型:攝取 → 分塊 → 嵌入 → 索引 → 檢索 → (重排) → 生成。資料更新後答案變得自信但錯誤、而模型沒變,先懷疑檢索層。

def_en: Splitting documents into retrievable units for RAG — a trade-off, not a constant: fixed-size + overlap for uniform prose; structure-aware for contracts/tables; small-to-big and contextual retrieval to balance precision against coherence.
def_zh: 把文件切成 RAG 可檢索的單元——是取捨,不是常數:均質散文用固定大小+重疊;合約/表格用結構感知;要平衡精準與連貫時用 small-to-big 與上下文化檢索。

def_en: The Claude Certified Developer — Foundations exam (v1.0, July 2026): 53 MC/MR items, 120 min, pass 720/1000, $125, valid 12 months. Eight domains — Applications & Integration alone is 33.1%; Claude Code just 3.1%. See Chapter 32.
def_zh: Claude Certified Developer — Foundations 考試(v1.0,2026 年 7 月):53 題單選/複選、120 分鐘、及格 720/1000、$125,效期 12 個月。八大領域——僅「應用與整合」就佔 33.1%;Claude Code 只有 3.1%。見第 32 章。

def_en: The Claude Certified Associate — Foundations exam (v1.0, July 2026): 60 MC/MR items, 120 min, pass 720/1000, $99, valid 12 months. Seven domains for practitioners using the Claude apps; Output Evaluation & Validation (21%) is the heaviest. See Chapter 33.
def_zh: Claude Certified Associate — Foundations 考試(v1.0,2026 年 7 月):60 題單選/複選、120 分鐘、及格 720/1000、$99,效期 12 個月。七大領域,面向使用 Claude 應用程式的實務者;「輸出評估與驗證」(21%)權重最高。見第 33 章。

def_en: Public-beta API aid for debugging prompt-cache misses: send the cache-diagnosis-2026-04-07 beta header and diagnostics.previous_message_id (the prior response's id), and the API returns a cache_miss_reason naming where the current prefix diverged from that turn. Replaces eyeballing two rendered prompts for a silent invalidator; a diagnostic only — caching behaviour is unchanged when the header is absent.
def_zh: 用於除錯提示快取落空的公開測試版 API 輔助:送出 cache-diagnosis-2026-04-07 beta 標頭與 diagnostics.previous_message_id(前一回合回應的 id),API 會回傳 cache_miss_reason,指出目前前綴與該回合在何處分岔。取代肉眼比對兩份算繪提示找無聲失效因子;純屬診斷——少了這個標頭,快取行為完全不變。

def_en: Claude Code setting that lists up to three models tried in order when the primary is overloaded or unavailable, so an unattended run degrades to the next tier instead of failing. Orthogonal to permission mode (which governs actions, not model availability); subagents and context compaction inherit the session's extended-thinking config, so a fallback keeps the reasoning budget you set.
def_zh: Claude Code 的設定,列出最多三個模型,在主模型過載或不可用時依序嘗試,讓無人值守的運行降級到下一層級而非失敗。與權限模式正交(權限管動作,不管模型可用性);子代理與上下文壓縮會繼承工作階段的延伸思考設定,所以後備模型保留你設定的推理預算。
